name: Physician
notion: A licensed medical healthcare professional authorized and responsible for diagnosing illnesses, managing clinical therapies, and caring for hospital patients.
impact: The physician assesses patient symptoms, orders clinical diagnostic tests, prescribes pharmaceutical treatments, and records diagnoses in medical records.

name: Doctor
notion: A qualified healthcare practitioner operating in the hospital environment who examines patients and administers clinical interventions.
impact: The doctor examines arriving patients, reviews laboratory results, determines therapy protocols, and updates clinical histories.

name: Medical Specialist
notion: A senior medical physician focused on a specific clinical branch responsible for specialized consultations and complex interventions.
impact: The medical specialist conducts advanced diagnostic examinations, interprets complex imaging data, and supervises specialized therapies.

name: Specialist Doctor
notion: A physician holding certified postgraduate specialization who handles focused clinical pathology and therapeutic decisions.
impact: The specialist doctor advises general clinicians, conducts targeted diagnostic procedures, and oversees specialized patient recovery.

name: Hospital Staff
notion: The administrative, clinical, and logistical personnel employed by the medical center to sustain institutional healthcare operations.
impact: Hospital staff assist clinicians, coordinate appointment scheduling, manage facility hygiene, and facilitate patient admissions.

name: Nurse
notion: A registered healthcare professional responsible for direct continuous bedside patient care, medication delivery, and vital sign monitoring.
impact: The nurse measures patient vitals, administers prescribed medication dosages, aids physicians during procedures, and reports clinical changes.

name: Triage Nurse
notion: A specialized emergency nurse stationed at patient intake to assess medical urgency and assign care prioritization tiers.
impact: The triage nurse evaluates incoming patient severity, takes initial vitals, and directs urgent cases into acute care rooms.

name: Emergency Triage Nurse
notion: An emergency department nurse tasked with immediate clinical intake assessment and urgency categorization of acute arrivals.
impact: The emergency triage nurse classifies patient distress levels and coordinates immediate bed assignment with emergency physicians.

name: Pharmacist
notion: A licensed health professional specializing in pharmaceutical science, drug safety verification, and therapeutic dispensing.
impact: The pharmacist reviews physician prescriptions, verifies drug compatibility and dosage, dispenses medication, and advises clinical teams.

name: Hospital Administrator
notion: An executive manager directing hospital resource allocation, departmental compliance, staffing policies, and clinical facility standards.
impact: The hospital administrator approves departmental budgets, oversees regulatory compliance, and coordinates hospital operations.

name: Clinical Director
notion: A senior medical officer responsible for governing clinical protocols, physician governance, and healthcare service quality throughout the hospital.
impact: The clinical director enforces institutional medical standards, supervises department heads, and audits healthcare delivery.

name: Patient
notion: An individual receiving medical examination, diagnostic testing, nursing care, or surgical treatment within the healthcare system.
impact: The patient provides symptom details, presents medical documentation, agrees to treatment plans, and attends follow-up consultations.

name: Hospital User
notion: An individual registered in the institutional hospital database accessing healthcare consultations and clinical services.
impact: The hospital user requests medical appointments, accesses diagnostic lab outcomes through the portal, and adheres to doctor guidance.

name: Pediatric Patient
notion: An infant, child, or adolescent receiving specialized developmental and medical healthcare from pediatric practitioners.
impact: The pediatric patient receives childhood medical attention while accompanied by legal guardians during consultations and therapies.

name: Child Patient
notion: A minor receiving medical examination, preventive vaccination, or acute pediatric treatment within the hospital children wing.
impact: The child patient undergoes clinical checks under parental supervision and follows tailored pediatric therapy plans.

name: Medical Record
notion: A formal confidential repository consolidating the complete medical history, diagnostic reports, and ongoing treatment notes of a patient.
impact: Physicians update the medical record during visits. Medical specialists review the record prior to surgery. Archival clerks store inactive files.

name: Clinical History
notion: A longitudinal health dossier recording previous illnesses, surgical interventions, family pathologies, and chronic treatment responses.
impact: The doctor examines the clinical history to prevent medication errors and documents current disease progression.

name: Electronic Health Record
notion: A digitized secure institutional database system containing real-time patient clinical records, prescriptions, and diagnostic lab data.
impact: Clinical staff query the electronic health record to retrieve patient health summaries and log clinical observations instantly.

name: EHR
notion: The common industry initialism for Electronic Health Record, denoting the digital software platform maintaining patient medical information.
impact: Physicians access the EHR at hospital workstations to review laboratory reports and place diagnostic orders.

name: Emergency Room
notion: A specialized acute care hospital facility designed for immediate diagnostic assessment and stabilization of critical injuries or sudden trauma.
impact: Ambulances transport acute patients to the emergency room. Emergency physicians stabilize traumatic conditions around the clock.

name: ER
notion: The standard abbreviation for Emergency Room, denoting the urgent hospital department handling acute medical situations.
impact: Triage nurses transfer urgent patients to the ER. Clinical specialists answer priority consultation calls in the ER.

name: Emergency Department
notion: The comprehensive hospital division responsible for emergency triage, urgent stabilization, and resuscitation of critical patients.
impact: The emergency department coordinates emergency intake, deploys trauma teams, and transfers stabilized patients to intensive units.

name: Accident and Emergency Ward
notion: The hospital ward dedicated to accepting and treating acute trauma victims, vehicular accident casualties, and emergency health crises.
impact: Trauma surgical staff operate in the accident and emergency ward to perform urgent lifesaving interventions.

name: Intensive Care Unit
notion: A high-dependency hospital department equipped with advanced life-support systems providing round-the-clock intensive care for critical patients.
impact: Intensivists manage complex mechanical ventilation and continuous hemodynamic monitoring for patients admitted to the intensive care unit.

name: ICU
notion: The universal medical acronym for Intensive Care Unit, designating the continuous critical care and life support ward.
impact: Specialists monitor critical vital indicators in the ICU and titrate emergency intravenous infusions.

name: Operating Room
notion: A sterile surgical theatre equipped with specialized operative instruments, surgical lights, and anesthesia monitoring stations.
impact: Surgeons and surgical nurses perform invasive operative procedures in the operating room under rigorous asepsis.

name: Surgery Theatre
notion: A specialized surgical suite within the hospital where surgical specialists carry out scheduled and emergency operative interventions.
impact: The surgical team sterilizes equipment in the surgery theatre and executes invasive operations on anesthetized patients.

name: Prescription
notion: An official medical directive authored by an authorized physician specifying drug names, dosage amounts, and administration routes.
impact: The physician generates the prescription for the patient. The pharmacist dispenses medication following prescription instructions.

name: Medication Order
notion: A formal clinical order entered into the hospital pharmacy system authorizing the preparation and administration of therapeutic pharmaceuticals.
impact: The doctor signs the medication order. Hospital pharmacy staff dispense the ordered drugs to the designated nursing ward.

name: Medication
notion: A pharmaceutical chemical substance formulated to treat medical conditions, alleviate physiological distress, or cure diseases.
impact: The pharmacist validates medication purity and compatibility. Nurses administer medication to inpatients according to schedule.

name: Pharmaceutical Drug
notion: A clinically approved medicinal compound manufactured for therapeutic disease management and pharmacological treatment.
impact: Physicians prescribe pharmaceutical drugs to manage acute and chronic pathologies in hospitalized patients.

name: Surgical Procedure
notion: An operative medical intervention performed on a patient to repair organ damage, excise diseased tissue, or correct physical trauma.
impact: The surgeon executes the surgical procedure in the operating theatre. Anesthesiologists manage patient stability during the procedure.

name: Surgical Operation
notion: An invasive clinical intervention carried out by surgical specialists to treat injuries or bodily ailments under surgical anesthesia.
impact: Surgical teams prepare instruments for the surgical operation and transfer the patient to recovery care upon conclusion.

name: Computed Tomography
notion: A non-invasive diagnostic medical imaging technology using cross-sectional X-rays to visualize internal organ and tissue anatomy.
impact: Radiology technicians perform computed tomography scans to detect internal fractures, vascular anomalies, and tumors.

name: CT
notion: The common medical initialism for Computed Tomography, designating cross-sectional diagnostic radiological scanning.
impact: Physicians review CT image slices to confirm acute trauma diagnoses and plan surgical interventions.

name: Vital Signs Monitor
notion: An electronic bedside clinical device continuously displaying patient heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and temperature.
impact: Nurses attach leads from the vital signs monitor to inpatients. The monitor alerts clinical staff if vital signs fluctuate abnormally.

name: Patient Monitor
notion: A bedside digital medical instrument that tracks and records ongoing physiological parameters of hospitalized individuals.
impact: The patient monitor triggers visual alarms when cardiac rhythms or pulse oxygen levels breach safe clinical boundaries.

name: Health Insurance
notion: A contractual healthcare policy providing financial coverage and reimbursement for hospital services, procedures, and medications.
impact: Administrative admission staff verify health insurance validity to authorize hospital coverage for scheduled inpatient treatments.

name: Medical Coverage
notion: The scope of clinical benefits and healthcare financial compensation provided by an insurance provider to offset medical costs.
impact: Hospital billing clerks process claims against patient medical coverage to settle treatment costs.

name: Diagnose
notion: The medical cognitive and observational process of identifying the pathology or condition underlying patient clinical symptoms.
impact: Step 1: The physician conducts an examination and takes patient history. Step 2: The doctor analyzes diagnostic test findings. Step 3: The physician documents the diagnostic conclusion.

name: Evaluate Pathology
notion: The comprehensive clinical assessment of symptoms, biopsy samples, and lab markers to determine the disease affecting a patient.
impact: Step 1: The clinical specialist reviews clinical symptoms. Step 2: The specialist evaluates laboratory markers. Step 3: The specialist records the confirmed pathological diagnosis.

name: Admit Patient
notion: The institutional process of formally receiving a patient into hospital custody and allocating them to an inpatient bed.
impact: Step 1: Staff confirm personal identity and medical necessity. Step 2: Nurses complete triage intake documentation. Step 3: The physician assigns the patient to an active ward bed.

name: Hospitalize Patient
notion: The medical action of placing an individual under continuous inpatient medical care within a hospital ward.
impact: Step 1: The clinician determines the requirement for continuous care. Step 2: Administrative clerks execute admission paperwork. Step 3: Nursing staff settle the patient into an inpatient room.

name: Discharge Patient
notion: The official medical and administrative release of a patient after achieving recovery and clinical stability.
impact: Step 1: The physician certifies clinical recovery. Step 2: The nurse explains home care guidelines. Step 3: Staff finalize administrative paperwork and release the patient.

name: Release Patient
notion: The formal authorization permitting a stabilized inpatient to depart the healthcare facility following completed therapy.
impact: Step 1: The doctor signs the discharge release order. Step 2: The clinical team provides outpatient medication instructions. Step 3: Administrative staff close the active stay file.

name: Under Treatment
notion: The clinical condition of a patient actively undergoing medication regimens, supervised procedures, or recovery therapies.
impact: From this state, if recovery milestones are achieved, the doctor transitions the patient to Discharged. If symptoms persist, therapy is adjusted.

name: In Active Therapy
notion: The status of an admitted patient receiving continuous supervised clinical therapies and medical interventions.
impact: From this state, clinical teams monitor daily therapeutic response until the patient reaches health stabilization.

name: Critical
notion: The hazardous clinical state of a patient with life-threatening vital instability requiring intensive mechanical life support.
impact: From this state, intensive care teams administer continuous resuscitation until the patient stabilizes or undergoes urgent surgery.

name: Stable
notion: The reassuring clinical condition where patient physiological vitals remain steady within acceptable safe ranges.
impact: From this state, the patient is considered for transfer from high-dependency units to a regular recovery ward.

name: Discharged
notion: The completed status of a patient who has concluded required clinical care and has been officially authorized to return home.
impact: From this state, active hospital monitoring ceases, inpatient billing is concluded, and records transition to institutional archives.

name: Medically Discharged
notion: The formal clinical status signifying that physician-mandated inpatient treatments are concluded and the patient is authorized for departure.
impact: From this state, outpatient follow-up appointments are scheduled and hospital stay records are closed.

name: Surgical Nurse
notion: A specialized perioperative nurse who prepares the sterile operating theatre, sterilizes surgical instruments, and assists surgeons directly during operative procedures.
impact: The surgical nurse maintains operating room sterility, passes surgical instruments to the surgeon, monitors sterile fields, and assists in surgical wound dressings.
